item.name: PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme
item.benefit: Collateral-free education loan up to Rs. 10 Lakhs with interest subvention for higher education
item.eligibility: Admission to top-ranked higher education institutions (UG/PG/Professional)
item.provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India

item.name: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC)
item.benefit: Tuition reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance via the National Scholarship Portal
item.eligibility: SC/ST/OBC students, Class 11 to PhD, family income under Rs. 2.5 Lakhs per year

item.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
item.benefit: Rs. 50,000 per annum for female students enrolled in technical degree or diploma programs
item.eligibility: Girls in AICTE-approved technical programmes, family income under Rs. 8 Lakhs

item.name: Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Scholarship (EBC)
item.benefit: 50% tuition and examination fee waiver for economically backward students
item.eligibility: Family income under Rs. 8 LPA, Maharashtra domicile, via MahaDBT

item.name: Central Sector Scheme (CSSS)
item.benefit: Rs. 10,000 - 20,000 per year merit-cum-means financial aid for college students
item.eligibility: Top 20th percentile in Class 12 boards, family income under Rs. 8 Lakhs

item.name: National Scholarship Portal
item.benefit: Multiple central and state scholarships for meritorious and disadvantaged students
item.eligibility: Eligible category students across income and merit criteria
item.provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India

item.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
item.benefit: Free GitHub Copilot, JetBrains suite, cloud credits (Azure, DigitalOcean) and free domains
item.eligibility: Students aged 13+ enrolled in a degree or diploma-granting course, verified with school email

item.name: Adobe Creative Cloud Student Discount
item.benefit: Over 60% discount on Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and the entire CC suite
item.eligibility: Verified students with a valid school email or student ID

item.name: Notion for Education
item.benefit: Free Personal Plus / Pro plan with unlimited file uploads
item.eligibility: Valid academic email (.edu / .ac.in), while enrolled

item.name: Spotify Premium Student
item.benefit: 50% discounted monthly rate for verified college students, up to 4 years
item.eligibility: SheerID-verified enrolled student

item.name: Amazon Prime Student
item.benefit: Six months free, then 50% off Prime — free delivery, Prime Video and shopping deals
item.eligibility: Verified student with a valid school/college email

item.name: Canva for Education
item.benefit: Free premium Canva Pro access for verified students and educators
item.eligibility: Students with a valid email ID, SheerID verification

item.eligibility: Verified students via .edu/.ac.in email
